observed_mechanism: Seed11step47 and seed21step104 lose row42 while real rows46/50/54 remain left of car. Substituting IMAGE_CENTER for row42 changes left road steering into right steering, then obstacle bias reinforces the wrong direction. Actual road loss follows two decisions later.
single_factor: In _adjust_road_steering only, when not straight, row42 absent, row54 present, at least3 observed centers and minimum observed row<=46, recompute raw steering from far=_center_at(42,centers) and near=centers[54] with unchanged .016/.012 gains, then pass to inherited hooks. np.interp clamps to observed endpoint, never extrapolates beyond it. Do not modify centers or road-visibility counts.
coupling: Inherited strong-steering speed/gas veto may activate on corrected geometry. This is expected existing behavior, not a second independently tuned change.
budget: One paired control/candidate per declared consumed cell, stop on operational or safety regression. No tuning within this comparison.
static_acceptance: missing54 and fewer-than3 observed rows unchanged
mirrored measured dropout cases maintain turn direction
no centers mutation or new persistent state
decision: Reject loss of a control finish, new off-track retirement on a control finisher, collision count/damage increase, reduced DNF progress, or >5% slower lap on any previously completed cell. Retain as development candidate if no regressions and finish count strictly increases, or same finishes with lower summed completed time. Wheel-contact sample counts are diagnostics, not comparable exposure after recovering a previously early DNF. No SOTA or unseen-generalization claim.
literature_application: Use a goal on observed path rather than invented centered coordinates. Metric pure-pursuit gains and world-pose inputs are not transplanted into the camera-only agent. report.pdf prior brake-regression evidence motivates geometry repair before faster targets.
